english.title: Failure to disclose information - terrorism
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having information which you knew or believed might be of material assistance in

(A)_[preventing the commission by another person of an act of terrorism,]_
(B)_[securing the apprehension, prosecution or conviction of another person, in the United Kingdom, for an offence involving the commission, preparation or instigation of an act of terrorism,]_

failed to disclose that information as soon as reasonably practicable to a constable
english.legislation: Contrary to section 38B of the Terrorism Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) It is a defence for a person to prove that he had a reasonable excuse for not making the disclosure.
(ii) Proceedings for an offence under this section may be taken, and the offence may for the purposes of those proceedings be treated as having been committed, in any place where the person to be charged is or has at any time been since he first knew or believed that the information might be of material assistance (subsection 38B(6)).
(iii) The penalty on indictment was increased to include a maximum of 10 years imprisonment from 12 April 2019; for offences from that date, please see document H19991.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
